question: With whom is the ‘Patharughat Uprising’ associated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Peasants’ uprising.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Patharughat** uprising is the **peasants' revolution** in the state of **Assam**.
 
• It **took place on 28th January 1894 in Patharughat** near Guwahati.
 
• The **major reason** behind the farmer's revolt is the **high rate of taxes imposed by the British government**.
 
• The **British government suppressed them on the grounds of sedition** and **opened fire on the peasants killing a large number of people**.
 
• The Assam state government has been **observing the day as Krishak Swahid Diwas** to commemorate the sacrifice and valour of the farmers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Some peasant uprisings:**

 
 
• **Rangpur Dhing** (1783) in Rangpur, Bengal.
 
• **Narkelberia** Uprising (1831) in Bengal
 
• **Pagal Panthi** Movement(1825) in the Bengal region
 
• **Pabna revolt** (1873-76) in the Bengal region(now Bangladesh)
 
• **Deccan Uprising** (1875) in Bombay Deccan region (present-day Pune & Ahmednagar)
